views.alt: A still from the video at 0:08, a vertical frame 1080 by 1920 px, with the L8 monogram at its top right. Near the top, chart S04 shows reported voting by age group, an open dot for 2020 and a solid dot for 2024 on a scale from 40 to 80 percent: 18 to 24, 51.4 in 2020 and 47.7 in 2024, down 3.7 points; 25 to 44, 62.6 and 60.2, down 2.4 points; 45 to 64, 71.0 and 70.0, too close to call (−1.0); 65 and over, 74.5 and 74.7, no clear change (+0.2). Under the chart, a Charcoal band holds the chart’s source line and then the captions. The source line reads “Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement, Table A-1, reported voting by age, and Table 1 with the Source and Accuracy statements, November 2020 and 2024, United States. Retrieved November 6 and 11, 2026. Self-reported voting among citizens 18 and over; margins of error computed by Oath & Action from the constants the Bureau publishes for that purpose.” The captions read “Citizens 18 to 24 reported voting at 47.7 percent, down 3.7 points”.
